tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed, per RTHK News: US agencies ordered to stop using DeepSeek AI tools.
Reported by Digit: OpenAI adds real-time collaboration to ChatGPT Slides, introduces other new features.
Confirmed, per The Economic Times: Chinese AI tool behind cyberattacks in Japan: security firm.
Reported by Pasquale Pillitteri: Anthropic pitches a bill to block AI only over $1 billion in damage or 50 deaths.
Reported by PPC Land: Draft bill tied to Anthropic would let courts halt AI models for 45 days.
